## Result and scope

- Claim comment URL and session: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/304#issuecomment-6866673815 (session `ADB991-claude-20261113-d7a1`)
- Unit IDs or other outputs: YM-000026; new report-only files `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C01/review/ADB991-claude-20261113-d7a1/{report.md,hashes.json}`. No manuscript, author-record, shared-file or `Lean/` change.
- Human contributors and agent assistance: Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission. Single agent, no subagents.

Independent review (mathematics and textual Lean correspondence) of hairer's PR #306 at `04dae86706fb64d4155e6883d76f510e63ae5eab` (merged as `ee1a8dc`), which adds `prop:ex-lattice-reflection-invariance` to `lattice.tex`. `lattice.tex` SHA-256 `cdd4d7ff…49d24f` (equal to the C01 `HANDOFF.md` entry, and byte-identical at the integration head `36a84131`).

**Outcome: no required change.** I rederived independently:
- the pullback formula, including the negatively oriented image of `a`-links;
- the involution property;
- invariance of the product Haar measure under relabelling plus inversion;
- all three plaquette cases, which give exactly the displayed conjugated inverse holonomies;
- `Re tr V^{-1} = Re tr V`, the bijections of `Λ_ℓ`, and invariance of the law.

The closing identification with the seam reflection `R_{p,a}` of `prop:ex-centered-planted` (`c = b_a + ℓp_a`, `κ = δ`, torus side `2hℓ`) is correct. That proposition's invariance hypothesis is now proved for the Wilson law. The text matches `YM.Wilson.law_pull` / `prior_pull` / `energy_pull` and `YM.Lattice.Face.send_price` (with `price_inv`, `price_conj`).

Minor notes:
- N1: `ℓ` denotes the torus side in the proposition but the cell side in the closing sentence.
- N2: measurability of `Θ` is asserted but not argued. It is continuous, hence Borel.

Optional notes:
- O1: `β ≥ 0` is not needed for invariance.
- O2: the source gives full signed-permutation and translation invariance.
- O3 (outside the PR): `prop:ex-centered-planted` calls `R_{p,a}` a "site reflection" even for link seams.
